description:
GBR Deluxe Steel Track Cog

The GBR Deluxe Steel Track Cog is a premium heat-treated steel track sprocket built for precise chain engagement, long service life and dependable velodrome performance.

Manufactured from high-grade, heat-treated steel, the GBR Deluxe is built to maintain tooth integrity and concentricity under repeated high-torque efforts. The material specification and controlled heat treatment are selected to deliver strong wear resistance and long-term dimensional stability, helping the sprocket retain its original tooth profile over extended use.

Each cog is CNC machined to tight tolerances, with particular focus on concentricity, tooth spacing and surface finish. This precision reduces drivetrain vibration, promotes smooth and predictable chain engagement, and helps minimise uneven chain wear. The result is quieter operation, improved drivetrain longevity and consistent power transfer from the first lap to the last.

Rather than relying on surface coatings or cosmetic treatments, the GBR Deluxe focuses on fundamental engineering quality. Optimised tooth geometry and refined finishing ensure reliable engagement across a wide range of track applications, from standing starts and sprint efforts to endurance training and racing.

Built specifically for velodrome use, the GBR Deluxe Steel Track Cog offers a high-quality, performance-focused steel option for riders who value durability, precision and dependable results session after session.

Key Features

High-Grade Heat-Treated Steel Construction
Selected for enhanced wear resistance, fatigue strength and long-term dimensional stability.

Developed specifically for the demands of fixed-gear track cycling.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is this cog suitable for track racing as well as training?
Yes. The GBR Deluxe Steel Track Cog is designed for both high-load training and race use. Its heat-treated steel construction and precision machining ensure consistent performance under sprint starts, standing efforts and sustained race loads.

What chains is this cog compatible with?
The GBR Deluxe Steel Track Cog is compatible with standard 1/8" track chains, including popular models used for both sprint and endurance track cycling.

Is this cog coated or surface treated?
No. This cog does not use any surface coatings. Performance is achieved through material selection, controlled heat treatment, precise machining and refined finishing rather than cosmetic or friction-reducing coatings.

How does this differ from basic steel track cogs?
Unlike entry-level steel cogs, the GBR Deluxe focuses on tighter tolerances, improved concentricity, optimised tooth geometry and controlled heat treatment. This results in smoother chain engagement, reduced drivetrain noise and better retention of tooth shape over time.

Is the cog suitable for sprint events and standing starts?
Yes. The cog is engineered to maintain tooth integrity and concentricity under repeated high-torque efforts, making it suitable for sprint training, standing starts and race use.

Will this cog help extend chain life?
The precision tooth profile and consistent concentricity help promote even chain loading, which can reduce uneven wear and contribute to longer chain service life when correctly maintained.

Where is the GBR Deluxe Steel Track Cog designed for use?
This cog is designed specifically for velodrome use on fixed-gear track bikes, but it can also be used in other fixed-gear applications.

Why Buy from Velodrome.Shop

Velodrome.Shop is dedicated exclusively to track cycling. Every product we offer is selected, developed or refined with a deep understanding of velodrome racing, training demands and drivetrain performance.

We focus on the engineering fundamentals that matter: material quality, precision machining, durability and real-world performance. Products are specified to meet the demands of modern track cycling, not marketing trends.

We supply track cyclists, teams and coaches around the world, from daily training riders to elite competitors, with components chosen for reliability and performance. We ship worldwide with secure packaging and reliable carriers, ensuring your equipment arrives ready for the track.

Our advice is grounded in practical track cycling experience. If you need help choosing gearing or drivetrain components, we are here to help.
